title: Spin before the Barcelona flight
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 40min spin at 120-135bpm, cadence 85-95rpm. Morning, before leaving for MXP (flight 16:45).
GYM: none.
FUEL: none. 1L water before the flight, 500ml on board.
GARMIN: ~35-45.
STOP RULE: quads still sore from Saturday's descents, cut to 25min.
WHY: flushes Sunday's legs at zero impact; Tue is the week's quality.
